description: Ranks one market segment by today's move, with trailing returns and a trend overlay per row, for relative strength inside it; energy adds the EU-buyable UCITS energy funds' facts. A curated cross-sector basket of names is get_stock_cards.

include_history.description: Include the raw ~22-session [unix_seconds, close] pairs per row. Default false — each row carries `last` and a `spark` over the same window.

name: get_market_heatmap
